data.task_title: Load and analyze pipeline execution data

features.title: Identify Optimization Areas
features.description: Develop functionality to identify areas in the pipeline that require optimization based on execution metrics.
acceptance_criteria: System highlights areas with high execution times
Users receive suggestions for potential optimizations
Optimization areas are updated in real-time

features.title: Visualize Execution Metrics
features.description: Create visualizations for pipeline execution metrics such as performance trends, execution times, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Users can view performance trend graphs
Execution times are displayed in a clear format
Success rates are visualized with charts

features.title: Analyze Pipeline Performance Trends
features.description: Implement analysis tools to evaluate pipeline performance trends over time.
acceptance_criteria: System can generate reports on performance trends
Users can filter trends by specific time periods
Analysis results are accurate and reliable

features.title: Load Pipeline Execution Data
features.description: Develop functionality to load execution data from Artemis pipelines into the analysis system.
acceptance_criteria: System can connect to the Artemis pipeline data source
Data loading process is logged for audit purposes
